newsitem.title: POLAND: ZEW share trade suspended due to floods.
newsitem.headline: ZEW share trade suspended due to floods.

text.p: The Warsaw bourse suspended trade in electrode maker ZEW SA from Thursday for an indefinite period of time due to the threat to the firm caused by the current flooding in southern Poland, a bourse deputy head said.

"Due to...a lack of access to information allowing an appraisal of the influence of the flood on the activity of the firm the bourse board decided to suspend its quotation," Wlodzimierz Magiera told a news conference.
Magiera said ZEW had informed the Securities Commission (KPW) by telephone that production had been halted at the firm in the southern town of Raciborz. ZEW fell 10 percent on Wednesday.
